prose: Neoclouds CoreWeave, Nebius and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the bond market in recent weeks as lenders and investors turn choosier and demand stricter terms - a sign the AI build-out is entering a new, less forgiving financing phase, the Wall Street Journal reports via sources. The article is paywalled to the fetcher (HTTP 401), so the figures come from the feed's report of the piece.
highlights: WSJ: CoreWeave, Nebius and Nscale effectively shut out of the bond market in recent weeks
Lenders demand tougher terms as the AI build-out enters a new financing phase
basis: Techmeme summary of the WSJ report; WSJ returns HTTP 401 to the fetcher
